text:
Hi Mara — Professor Alvarez. I'd like to set up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week, 30 minutes. My open slots are:
- Mon 10:00-10:30
- Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30
- Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30
- Wed 13:00-13:30
Which of those work for you? If none do, tell me what does and I'll see what I can move.

Hi Sarah — Professor Alvarez. I'd like to set up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week, 30 minutes. My open slots are:
- Mon 10:00-10:30
- Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30
- Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30
- Wed 13:00-13:30
Which of those work for you? If none do, tell me what does and I'll see what I can move.

Hi John — Professor Alvarez. I'd like to set up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week, 30 minutes. My open slots are:
- Mon 10:00-10:30
- Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30
- Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30
- Wed 13:00-13:30
Which of those work for you? If none do, tell me what does and I'll see what I can move.

Hi Professor — thanks for laying out the slots.

Honestly, none of them work for me next week: my part of the CSE455 material isn't ready yet and I'd rather not sit down on it before it is. I'd rather say that than juggle the calendar around it.

Could we aim for the week after instead? Same slots work for me then — Mon Nov 30 10:00 or 14:00, Tue Dec 1 11:00 or 15:00, Wed Dec 2 10:00 or 13:00. Pick whichever suits you and I'll confirm.

If next week is important for you and the others, I'm happy to be there and to give a status on my section rather than a full review.

Thanks Mara — that's a fair answer, and I'd rather have it straight than a rearranged calendar.

Let me hear from Sarah and John. If next week works for them I'll schedule it then and you can give a status on your section instead of a full review; if they're free the week after too, I'll push the whole thing to Nov 30-Dec 2 and use one of your slots.

Sounds good — either way is fine by me. I'll be there for a status next week if that's what works for the others, and I'll block one of the Nov 30–Dec 2 slots in case the meeting moves. Just tell me which and I'll confirm.
Will do — you'll have the day and time from me as soon as Sarah and John answer.
Monday 10:00-10:30 works — my 10:30 slot was free. Booking it now; I'll confirm once it's on the calendar.
Checking my calendar against your slots — one moment.

Good — hold Monday 10:00-10:30 and don't put it on your calendar yet. Mara can't do next week (her section isn't ready; she'd come for a status only), and I haven't heard from John. If next week holds I'll confirm Monday 10:00 and book it here too; if it moves to Nov 30-Dec 2 I'll tell you before you block anything.
Confirmed — CSE455 staff meeting, Monday 10:00-10:30. It's on my calendar now. See you then!
Update: Sarah is free Monday 10:00-10:30 next week. If John is too, I'll take that and you'll just give a status. If John can't, I'll move it to Nov 30-Dec 2 and ask you to pick a slot.

Ah — you were quicker than my last message. Nothing is fixed yet: Mara can't do next week and John hasn't answered, so please take Monday 10:00-10:30 back off your calendar for now. I'll confirm the real time within the hour and you can put it back on then. Sorry for the churn.
Good to know. I'll keep Mon 10:00–10:30 open either way, so if John can make it next week I'm there with a status; if not, say the word and I'll take one of the Nov 30–Dec 2 slots.
Perfect. I'll tell you the moment John answers.

Hi Professor — happy to set that up.

Monday 14:00-14:30 works for me, so I've booked it: CSE455 staff meeting, Mon 14:00-14:30. I only took 30 minutes, as you asked.

For the record, of your other slots: Mon 10:00-10:30 clashes with my CSE455 office hours (09:00-10:30); the rest (Tue 11:00, Tue 15:00, Wed 10:00, Wed 13:00) were free too, but Monday 14:00 was the earliest and I went with it.

If you'd rather move it, just say and I'll switch.

No problem — it's off my calendar again. I'm holding Monday 10:00-10:30 tentatively and won't put anything back on until you confirm the real time. If it moves to Nov 30-Dec 2, just say so and I'll re-check my week before blocking.

Thanks John. Hold Monday 14:00-14:30 but don't treat it as final yet: Sarah has Monday 10:00-10:30 free, Mara can't prepare for next week at all (her section isn't ready — she'd come for a status only) and offered the week after, Nov 30-Dec 2. Can you do Monday 14:00-14:30 next week, and would Nov 30 10:00-10:30 also work for you as a fallback? Two answers and I'll decide today.
Thanks — and noted on your office hours, I won't ask you to move them. Wait for one more message from me before you treat Monday 14:00 as final.
Thanks Sarah — that's the right way to hold it. Decision as soon as John confirms.
One more check, Sarah: is Monday 14:00-14:30 next week free for you too? John is free then, and if you are as well I'd rather hold one slot that suits both of you.
Understood — I'll hold Monday 14:00-14:30 as tentative, not final, and wait for your next message. Checking Nov 30 now.
Thank you.

Monday 14:00-14:30 is taken for me — I have a study group 13:50-14:50, so I can't make that one.

Of your list, the slots that work on my side are:
- Mon 10:00-10:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30 and Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30 and Wed 13:00-13:30

Mon 10:00-10:30 is still the one I'm holding for you; if John is free then too, that seems the simplest for both of us. Tell me the confirmed slot and I'll put it on my calendar.
Small caveat on my list, so it's accurate: Tue 11:00-11:30 cuts into my lunch, which I can shift if needed — the others (Mon 10:00, Tue 15:00, Wed 10:00, Wed 13:00) are clean.

Two answers:

1. Monday 14:00-14:30 next week: yes, that works for me. Still held tentative as you asked.

2. Monday Nov 30, 10:00-10:30: no, I can't — that's inside my CSE455 office hours (09:00-10:30), same as the Mon 10:00 slot next week. If the fallback week is on the table, these work for me instead:
- Mon Nov 30 14:00-14:30
- Tue Dec 1 11:00-11:30
- Tue Dec 1 15:00-15:30
- Wed Dec 2 10:00-10:30
- Wed Dec 2 13:00-13:30

So: Monday 14:00-14:30 next week yes; Nov 30 at 10:00 no, but Nov 30 at 14:00 yes.

Then we're settled: CSE455 staff meeting, **Tuesday 11:00-11:30** next week. You listed Tue 11:00 as free, and so did John; Monday 10:00 doesn't work for John (his office hours run to 10:30), so Tuesday is the earliest slot all of us can make. Put it on your calendar and you're done. If anything changes on my side I'll tell you at once.

Thanks for the caveat — that settles it. Final: **CSE455 staff meeting, Tuesday 15:00-15:30** next week. It's clean in your list, it's free for John, and it's on my calendar now (15:00 was my grant-writing block, which I'll absorb). Forget my "Tuesday 11:00" message — please don't put 11:00 anywhere. Confirm whenever you've added Tuesday 15:00-15:30.

That's what I needed. Final: **CSE455 staff meeting, Tuesday 15:00-15:30** next week — free for you, clean for Sarah, and now on my calendar. So Monday 14:00 is off; take it off your calendar and put Tuesday 15:00-15:30 on instead. Nov 30 stays in reserve; we won't need it.

Settled for next week: CSE455 staff meeting, **Tuesday 15:00-15:30**. Sarah and John can both make it, so come with a status on your section rather than a full review, as you offered. You can release the Nov 30-Dec 2 hold; if we need the full review later I'll schedule it separately.

Confirmed — CSE455 staff meeting, Tuesday Nov 24, 15:00–15:30, on my calendar. I'll come with a status on my section. The Nov 30–Dec 2 hold is released; if you want the full review later, just name a slot and I'll take it.
Done: Monday 14:00-14:30 is off my calendar and Tuesday 15:00-15:30 is on — CSE455 staff meeting, Tue 15:00-15:30. Nov 30 stays in reserve, unused. See you Tuesday.

Hold on — I have to correct myself before I book that. I said Tue 11:00 worked, but I was reading it wrong: my seminar runs 09:50-11:10, so 11:00-11:30 isn't actually free for me. Sorry.

What does work on Tuesday:
- **11:10-11:40** (my seminar ends at 11:10; it runs into my lunch, but lunch I can shift)
- **15:00-15:30** (fully free)
- and Wednesday **10:00-10:30** or **13:00-13:30** (both fully free)

If John is free at 11:00, 11:10-11:40 costs nobody anything on my side. Tell me which one and I'll block it right away.
Thank you, Mara. Tuesday it is.

No harm done — 15:00-15:30 is exactly what I already confirmed and what's on my calendar, and you listed it as fully free. Nothing changes: **CSE455 staff meeting, Tuesday 15:00-15:30**, please book that one. 11:10-11:40 isn't needed.
Done — **CSE455 staff meeting, Tuesday 15:00-15:30** is on my calendar, and nothing is booked at 11:00 (or 11:10). Thanks for sorting it out with John; see you Tuesday.
Good. See you Tuesday, Sarah.

Good afternoon — Professor Alvarez here (CSE455). For the department schedule: I've booked the CSE455 staff meeting for Tuesday, November 24, 15:00-15:30. Attendees: me, Sarah, John and Mara. It replaces nothing on the official schedule; Tuesday 15:00 was my grant-writing block, which I'll absorb. Please note it if you keep staff meetings, and tell me if it clashes with anything official.

Good afternoon, Professor Alvarez. Noted: CSE455 staff meeting, Tuesday 24 November, 15:00-15:30, with Sarah, John and Mara.

No clash with the official schedule: on Tuesday the CSE452 lecture ends at 15:00 and CSE455 office hours begin at 15:30, so that half hour is free. Nothing else official sits in it.

I keep no record of anyone's private appointments, so I can only confirm the official calendar.

Thank you — that confirms what I needed.

One thing worth flagging: you say CSE455 office hours begin Tuesday at 15:30, but my own calendar has Tuesday 15:30-16:30 as a research meeting, and my CSE455 office hours are Friday 15:20-17:00. Either my record is wrong or the official one is. Could you check which is on the official schedule for Tuesday 15:30-16:30? It doesn't affect the staff meeting — that ends at 15:30 either way — but I'd rather have the two records agree.

Both entries are on the official schedule, so neither record is wrong:

- Tue 15:30-16:20 — CSE455 office hours (no name attached in the official listing)
- Fri 15:20-17:00 — CSE455 office hours (Professor Alvarez)

Tuesday 16:20-17:00 then has CSE455 quiz section. So the Tuesday slot exists officially, and your Friday one does too; the Tuesday listing simply isn't attributed to you. That's all I can say from the official schedule — I don't have anyone's private appointments.
That explains it — Tuesday's is unattributed, most likely a TA's hour, while mine is Friday. I'll leave the official schedule alone and keep my own records as they are. Thanks for checking.
You're welcome, Professor Alvarez.
